meta.title: refactor: Fold persistence Into Role Folders (db / stores / auth)
meta.body:
### Overview
Third in the layout stack (#94 → #95 → this): `packages/persistence`'s 16 flat `src/` files folded into role folders. Stacked on #95; merge in order, rebases are clean (disjoint packages).

**Pure restructure — zero behavior change.** Every moved file is byte-identical except relative-import paths (verified per-file against the base branch). `lib.ts` re-exports the exact same symbol set; the D2b containment is untouched (`AppDrizzle` + `internal()` stay module-private, now in `db/handle.ts`).

### Layout
```
src/
  lib.ts              ENTRY — sectioned re-exports = the public surface
  testing.ts          ENTRY (persistence/testing) — PGlite harness + graphile stub
  types.ts            branded ids + Result/ValueOf re-export
  db/                 the opaque handle + its lifecycle
    handle.ts  config.ts  migrate.ts
  schema/             drizzle table definitions (unchanged)
  stores/             ctx-bound + projection data access
    tenant.ts  artifact-store.ts  generation.ts  ingest.ts  purge.ts  audit.ts  user-settings.ts
  auth/               PRE-tenant resolvers (they PRODUCE the tenant) + crypto
    session.ts  token.ts  crypto.ts
```
`testing.ts` stays at root — it is the `exports["./testing"]` subpath target (path unchanged for the api/cli test consumers). Rename along the move: `db.ts` → `db/handle.ts` (kills the `db/db.ts` stutter; matches the "opaque handle" vocabulary).

### Changelog
- Moved 13 files into `db/` / `stores/` / `auth/`; root keeps `lib.ts`, `testing.ts`, `types.ts`
- `lib.ts` rewritten as sectioned re-exports grouped by folder (same symbols, per-export docs + D2b containment note kept)
- `AGENTS.md`: package map + entry-points callout; `src/db.ts` / `src/audit.ts` references updated
- Test imports updated; two stale comment paths fixed (`packages/types/src/lib.ts`, `packages/worker/src/payload.ts` pointed at `persistence/src/ingest.ts`)

### Verification
- persistence: 149 tests pass, `tsc --noEmit` clean
- Dependents: api (141) + worker (34) + cli (69) + apps/web (532) all pass, all typecheck
- Repo-root `pnpm lint` exit 0
- Per-file old-path→new-path diffs: import lines only; import graph verified cycle-free (schema → db → stores → auth)
- CI checks will show the known billing failures — local runs above are the substitute, same as #94/#95.
